spec_quote: The clock divider within the module uses this parameter to generate a one-second pulse (`one_sec_pulse`).
fix: Increment seconds when the divider reaches its terminal count (e.g., `count == 3` for CLK_FREQ=4) instead of waiting for the registered `pulse` on the next cycle. Change condition to `if count == 3 and start_stop == 1:` and update seconds accordingly; do not gate on the delayed `pulse`.
